findings.description: The KMS key defines no `policy` attribute, so AWS applies the default key policy that grants the root account full control. More importantly, there is no explicit, least-privilege key policy restricting which principals may use the key for encryption/decryption; any identity that the (possibly broad) account-level IAM policies allow can use the key. Define an explicit key policy limiting principals and key usage.

`enable_key_rotation` is not set to true, so automatic annual rotation of the backing key material is disabled. Without rotation, a compromised or leaked key material remains valid indefinitely, increasing the impact of any exposure.
